zh: the original US amusement park opened by Walt Disney in 1955 at Anaheim, California and now known as Disneyland Park. It is divided into different 'lands' such as Adventureland, Frontierland and Tomorrowland. There are also hotels, restaurants and theatres in the area around it, and the whole site is known as Disneyland Resort. Similar parks built later are Disney World which opened in 1971, Tokyo Disneyland (1983), Disneyland Paris (1992), Hong Kong Disneyland (2005) and Shanghai Disneyland (2016).

这次展览为当地艺术家提供了展示自己作品的机会。

来信的语气使她不快。

显然，他看到她在那里感到既惊讶又不高兴。

他的话显然并没使她不快。

她没有掩饰自己对前景并不乐观。

the fact that something is available
